dedupe_keys.name: western kazakhstan industrial waste chemistry and construction material tests

description: This deposit describes industrial waste compositions and experimental materials produced from them in Western Kazakhstan. The research team sampled oil and gas, ferroalloy and chemical-industry waste streams and investigated their use in construction products. Mendeley version 3 contains six Excel tables: four chemical-composition tables and two sets of spectroscopic or X-ray observations. Coverage concerns selected enterprises and laboratory specimens, with no uniform calendar sampling period established. The documentation discusses petroleum sulphur and chromium-bearing sludge reactions, but the review does not treat those claims as proof of safe products. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Small experimental scope and site-specific waste chemistry are limitations for transferring process assumptions. Modellers could use composition inputs and material observations in recycling-process simulations. platform-openlca is a related assessment tool, requiring additional process inventories and impact factors. No workbook, toxicity test or thermodynamic calculation was downloaded or checked.
